hypothesis: Block roles and protected original-image atoms plus separation of auxiliary/float content improve structural fidelity over page-level k2 without regenerating text.
k2: reuse same v2 -0.2 harness and same source/destination DPI and 390px width
rules: Expand each detector proposal by1PDFpoint then close over intersecting native glyph bounding boxes
Merge overlapping proposals; mixed-role components are protected, never forced into text
Join detected formula_number to nearest vertically overlapping detected formula
Only confident text/abstract/content/reference-only components are eligible for unchanged k2
Reject a region to original image if k2 source-map ink coverage is incomplete or duplicated
Use baseline k2 map rank for main-flow block order; this is a proposal needing visual audit, not ground truth
Preserve formula/headings in main flow; put detected figures/tables/algorithms/captions after main flow; put detected footnotes/headers/page numbers in auxiliary section
Unassigned ink retained in masked original-page panel; never discard or count as successful reflow
No semantic re-recognition, manual object boxes, per-paper branches, or model/threshold tuning
stopping_condition: Exactly2newpages, one baseline and one protection pipeline each. Report failure if relationship damage remains, safe reflow collapses, or resource limit is reached. No same-page repairs or extra engines.
scope: New pages for this workflow, executor-selected and self-audited; not independently reviewed or a corpus accuracy estimate.
public_export_note: Path-only relocation and removal of private coordination/download incident details. Original freeze remains unchanged locally; archived source code bytes unchanged.
